source_evidence: MicroClay.retrieve persists retrieval_id + turn_id + episode_id + causal_id + generation per round.
_microclay_schatten explicitly creates fresh per-round turn_id, episode_id and causal_id.
MicroClay._apply_credit binds feedback receipt identity to retrieval_id + causal_id + generation after the target row is selected.

_kognition_richten_hook receives only session_id + transcript_path, chooses newest same-session uncredited retrieval with ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1, and separately reconstructs the last user transcript text.
Current source records a prior session-level turn/episode identity bug that silently reduced MicroClay to one retrieval episode per session until per-round identities were introduced.
Stop invokes model relevance before later deterministic GW/governance/waiting bookkeeping; event-wide timeout aborts the remaining Stop body.
